comment:
* A listener transport manager which handles mappings between the client facing listener and system
 * server facing transport. Supports transports which may be removed either from the client side or
 * from the system server side without leaking memory.
 *
 * @param <TTransport>> transport type

methods.name: public final void addListener(Object key, TTransport transport)
methods.comment: * Adds a new transport with the given listener key.

methods.name: public final void removeListener(Object key)
methods.comment: * Removes the transport with the given listener key.

methods.name: protected abstract void registerTransport(TTransport transport) throws RemoteException
protected void registerTransport(TTransport transport, TTransport oldTransport) throws RemoteException
methods.comment:
* Registers a new transport that is replacing the given old transport. Implementations must
     * ensure that if they throw a remote exception, the call does not have any side effects.

methods.name: protected abstract void unregisterTransport(TTransport transport) throws RemoteException
